# Overdue fines and accrual

An overdue fine accrues at 0.15 per open day per item, beginning the day after
the due date. Fines do not accrue on days the branch is closed, and they do not
accrue on children's cards, which are fine-free by standing policy.

The accrual ceiling for a single item is 12.00. Once an item reaches the ceiling
it stops accruing an overdue fine and is instead converted to a lost-item charge
after a further 14 days; the conversion is described in the lost item
replacement policy, and the overdue fine already accrued is folded into the
replacement charge rather than billed separately.

Borrowing is blocked once unpaid charges on an account exceed 25.00. Payment may
be made at any service desk, through the catalogue account page, or by post.

An overdue fine is never charged for an item returned to a book drop before the
drop is emptied on the morning of the first open day after the due date.
